title: Black Henna Hair Colour Brazilian Black

details.description: Banjara's Black Henna Hair Colour in Brazilian Black with henna, amla, brahmi, shikakai, bhringraj, fenugreek, hibiscus and indigo. Ammonia-free.
details.usageInstructions: Mix the powder with water into a paste, apply on hair, leave for 1 to 2 hours and rinse.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Do a patch test 48 hours before use. Avoid contact with eyes; if it happens, rinse well with water. Do not use if you have a skin allergy or scalp irritation. Keep away from children.

details.description: Banjara's Black Henna Shampoo Hair Colour gives instant natural black in about 8 minutes with 100% grey coverage. Pack of 10 sachets of 10ml.
details.usageInstructions: Apply on wet hair, lather, leave for 8 minutes and rinse.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Do a patch test 48 hours before use. Avoid contact with eyes; if it happens, rinse well with water. Do not use if you have a skin allergy or scalp irritation. Keep away from children.
